items.difficulty_reason: The counted proposition is the author proposition at source lines 733-736: the function num(n) giving the Goedel number of the numeral for n is primitive recursive. The author proof (738-747) is complete as an explicit primitive recursion: num(0) is the Goedel number of the symbol 0, and num(n+1) concatenates the Goedel numbers of the prime symbol, num(n), and the closing parenthesis. The recursion schema with the constant and concatenation functions already established primitive recursive in the unit yields the claim; nothing beyond the unit's established stock is used.
